# Surya's Solar - Rooftop Solar Installer in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu

> Surya's Solar (also written "Suryas Solar") designs and installs residential and commercial rooftop solar systems in Cuddalore and nearby towns (Puducherry, Panruti, Neyveli, Chidambaram, Villupuram). We handle PM Surya Ghar subsidy paperwork and TNEB / TNPDCL net metering end to end.

## Company facts
- Name: Surya's Solar
- Address: No.33, Sri Gokul Enterprises Building, Nellikuppam Main Rd, Chavadi, Kondur, Cuddalore - 607006, Tamil Nadu, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 7904369094 (also +91 9655989595)
- Email: suryassolarenergy@gmail.com
- Hours: Open all 7 days, Monday to Sunday, 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM
- Website: https://www.suryassolar.com
- Google rating: 5.0 from 45 Google reviews (Oct 2026)
- Track record: 10+ years experience; 120+ homes, 420 kW installed
- Official partners: TATA Power Solar and Exide
- Service areas: Cuddalore, Puducherry (Pondicherry), Panruti, Neyveli, Chidambaram, Villupuram
- Engineering standards: 3 separate earthing pits (AC, DC, lightning arrester), UV-rated DC cables, hot-dip galvanized structures for coastal salt air, Tier-1 ALMM-listed panels, 25-year panel warranty

## Typical prices (on-grid, Tamil Nadu, 2026)
- 3kW: ₹1,80,000 - ₹2,00,000 before subsidy; about ₹1,10,000 after PM Surya Ghar subsidy. Suits monthly bills of ₹1,500 - ₹3,500. Generates about 12-15 units per day.
- 5kW: ₹3,00,000 - ₹3,30,000 before subsidy; about ₹2,40,000 after subsidy. Suits monthly bills of ₹4,000 - ₹7,000.
- PM Surya Ghar subsidy: ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2kW plus ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW = ₹78,000 maximum (3kW and above).
- Tamil Nadu state top-up (G.O. 102, Sept 2026): ₹5,000 (1kW), ₹10,000 (2kW), ₹22,000 (3kW+), so a Tamil Nadu home can get up to ₹1,00,000 in total. Residential connections registered on PM Surya Ghar from 5 Aug 2026; reported limit of the first 1 lakh homes. Not applicable in Puducherry.
- Surya's Solar is a registered vendor on the official PM Surya Ghar portal: 122 installations, 420 kWp, rated 5/5 from 149 ratings (Oct 2026).
- Final price depends on roof type, structure height, panel/inverter brand and site conditions. Free home visit for an exact quote.
